title: Mallard-Style Duck Call (5-part kit)
description: Original turned-style single-reed duck call: barrel with beaded rings, tone insert with air channel and reed window, flat reed strip, clamp wedge and flared bell. Parts print separately and press together.
use: Birdwatching/hobby game-calling accessory and a fun acoustics project. Use lawfully and follow local regulations.
material: PETG or PLA for body parts (0.12-0.16 mm layers, 100% perimeters). Reed: cut from clear PET film (0.15-0.25 mm) using the reed template outline; the printed 0.3 mm reed is only an optional experiment.
assembly: 1. Press the tone insert into the barrel from the exit end until it seats on the internal shoulder, deck (flat side) facing the side you will place the reed.
2. Lay the reed strip flat on the deck, its square end toward the mouthpiece, covering the window.
3. Press the clamp wedge in over the reed base (flat face down onto the reed) until flush with the insert deck start.
4. Press the bell spigot into the barrel exit until its flange meets the barrel end.
5. Blow from the mouthpiece with a short "quack" of air; adjust wedge position / reed length to tune.
fit_notes: Joint clearances: press-fit joints are modelled with 0.10 mm radial clearance (0.20 mm on diameter); sliding joints 0.25 mm radial. If a press-fit is loose wrap one turn of PTFE (plumber) tape or a dab of glue; if tight, sand lightly - do not force. Not tested by test-printing or acoustic measurement. Sound depends on your printer, filament, reed film and fit - expect to tune.
fit_check: parts built in assembled pose and boolean-intersected pairwise: no interference found
